newsitem.title: USA: BASF's Knoll unit gets FDA OK for Mavik.
newsitem.headline: BASF's Knoll unit gets FDA OK for Mavik.

text.p: Knoll Pharmaceutical Co, a unit of BASF Corp, said Thursday its product Mavik received the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's marketing clearance for patients with left ventricular dysfunction after a heart attack.

Mavik, which comes in tablet form, has been available in the U.S. since June 1996 for treatment of hypertension, Knoll said. Knoll is part of BASF Pharma, the global pharmaceutical division of BASF AG.

Knoll noted that drug treatments after a heart attack may may include several prescription therapies, including Mavik. The drug reduces the workload of the heart muscle and helps improve the blood flow through coronary arteries by dilating both small arteries and veins, it said.
